faq.q: Our house is a new build and the yard is still dirt. Can you start from that?
faq.a: Yes. Our Modern Living job in Figtree was the front and back of a new home: Besser Block retaining walls, a coloured concrete driveway, tropical planting, Matilda Buffalo turf and a SMART irrigation system.

Yes, in masonry and timber. On our own jobs: a reinforced Besser Block wall faced with sandstone stackstone in Port Kembla, a curved Tasman Block wall in Flinders, a sandstone boulder wall in Kiama, a timber wall in Wollongong and a concrete sleeper wall in Wongawilli. Excavation and drainage are on our construction list too.

faq.q: What does a landscaping job cost?
faq.a:
We do not publish a price list. We start by understanding your vision and setting out the scope of work, then you get a concept and a professionally presented quote. Design fees start from .

From one customer's review: “…Timelines and budgets were accurate…” Most builds of this kind land between , though that depends entirely on scope.

faq.q: Will the site be a mess while you are here?
faq.a: We work to minimise the disruption to your property during the job. We treat your home as our own.

faq.q: Can the irrigation be run from my phone?
faq.a: Yes. We fit SMART irrigation systems such as SkyDrop, which connect to your home wifi so you can control the watering from your own lounge. We also fit automatic systems and driplines, and we are a preferred supplier of Reece Irrigation.

faq.q: Do you look after it afterwards?
faq.a: Yes. Maintenance is one of our four services: lawn mowing, weeding and pruning, mulching, fertilising and aeration, and rubbish removal.
